record.question: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting round the circle and are facing the centre: 1.P is second to the right of T who is the neighbour of R and V. 2.S is not the neighbour of P. 3.V is the neighbour of U. 4.Q is not between S and W. W is not between U and S. Which two of the following are not neighbours?
record.explanation: R and V are separated by T, so they are not neighbours.
